# Data Loading and Setup

```{r}
DATA_PATH    <- "All_Data_1884_2013_0215_193821.csv"
AFM_DIR      <- "afm_outputs_rolling_new"
OUTPUT_FILE  <- "student_week_aggregations_rolling_new.csv"

# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists(AFM_DIR)) {
  dir.create(AFM_DIR, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

# Key variables

```{r}
# Rolling window size (in weeks)
ROLLING_WINDOW_SIZE <- as.numeric(Sys.getenv("ROLLING_WINDOW_SIZE", "4"))  # Use last 4 weeks of data for each model

# Control how duration is calculated
USE_PROVIDED_DURATION <- TRUE  

# Control how proficiency is calculated
PROFICIENCY_METHOD <- Sys.getenv("PROFICIENCY_METHOD", "new_skills_mastered")

# Random seed for reproducible student splitting
STUDENT_SAMPLE_SEED <- 42      

# Outlier removal for durations
REMOVE_DURATION_OUTLIERS <- as.logical(Sys.getenv("REMOVE_DURATION_OUTLIERS", "TRUE"))
TUKEY_K <- as.numeric(Sys.getenv("TUKEY_K", "1.5"))

# Parallel processing
N_CORES <- as.numeric(Sys.getenv("N_CORES", parallel::detectCores() - 1))  # Leave one core free by default

# Debug mode - run sequentially
DEBUG_MODE <- as.logical(Sys.getenv("DEBUG_MODE", "FALSE"))
```

# Libraries

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)      
  library(dplyr)      
  library(tidyr)

  library(fs)         
  library(stringr)    
  library(tibble)

})

source("data_cleaning_helpers.R")
```

# 1. Load and preprocess data

```{r}
cat("Loading and preprocessing data...\n")

raw <- read_delim(DATA_PATH, delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
         clean_names()

cat("Raw data loaded:\n")
cat("  Total rows:", nrow(raw), "\n")
cat("  Total unique students:", n_distinct(raw$anon_student_id), "\n")

# Parse dates and create week identifiers
d_with_week_id <- raw %>%
  mutate(
    step_start_datetime = ymd_hms(step_start_time),
    duration_sec = if (USE_PROVIDED_DURATION) {
      as.numeric(step_duration_sec)
    } else {
      step_end_datetime <- ymd_hms(step_end_time)
      as.numeric(difftime(step_end_datetime, step_start_datetime, units = "secs"))
    },
    week_year = isoyear(step_start_datetime),
    week_num = isoweek(step_start_datetime),
    week_id = paste0(week_year, "-W", sprintf("%02d", week_num))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(step_start_datetime))

# Apply duration outlier removal
if (REMOVE_DURATION_OUTLIERS) {
  valid_durations <- d_with_week_id %>%
    filter(!is.na(duration_sec) & duration_sec > 0) %>%
    pull(duration_sec)
  
  box_stats <- boxplot.stats(valid_durations, coef = TUKEY_K)
  lower_fence <- 0  # Durations can't be negative
  upper_fence <- box_stats$stats[5]
  
  d_with_week_id <- d_with_week_id %>%
    filter(is.na(duration_sec) | (duration_sec >= lower_fence & duration_sec <= upper_fence))
  
  cat("Duration outliers removed. Upper fence:", round(upper_fence, 1), "seconds\n")
}

# Apply student sampling and create two groups
all_students <- unique(d_with_week_id$anon_student_id)
n_total <- length(all_students)
n_30_percent <- ceiling(n_total * 0.30)

cat("Total students in raw data:", n_total, "\n")

set.seed(STUDENT_SAMPLE_SEED)
# Randomly shuffle all students
shuffled_students <- sample(all_students, size = n_total, replace = FALSE)

# Split into 30% and 70% groups
steve_dang_30_students <- shuffled_students[1:n_30_percent]
steve_dang_70_students <- shuffled_students[(n_30_percent + 1):n_total]

cat("\nCreating two non-overlapping student groups:\n")
cat("  steve_dang_30:", length(steve_dang_30_students), "students (30%)\n")
cat("  steve_dang_70:", length(steve_dang_70_students), "students (70%)\n")

# Store original data for both groups
d_with_week_id_30 <- d_with_week_id %>%
  filter(anon_student_id %in% steve_dang_30_students)
d_with_week_id_70 <- d_with_week_id %>%
  filter(anon_student_id %in% steve_dang_70_students)

# For the main AFM processing, we'll use the 30% group
d_with_week_id <- d_with_week_id_30
cat("Using steve_dang_30 group for AFM model fitting\n")

# Process skills for both groups
d_with_skills_30 <- d_with_week_id_30 %>%
  separate_longer_delim(c(kc_sub_skills, opportunity_sub_skills), delim = "~~") %>%
  clean_skills_systematic("kc_sub_skills", min_length = 10, verbose = FALSE)

d_with_skills_70 <- d_with_week_id_70 %>%
  separate_longer_delim(c(kc_sub_skills, opportunity_sub_skills), delim = "~~") %>%
  clean_skills_systematic("kc_sub_skills", min_length = 10, verbose = FALSE)

# Build AFM-ready data for both groups
d_afm_30 <- d_with_skills_30 %>%
  transmute(
    anon_student_id = anon_student_id,
    week_id = week_id,
    kc_sub_skills = kc_sub_skills,
    n_opportunity = as.integer(opportunity_sub_skills),
    outcome_bin = case_when(
      first_attempt == "correct" ~ 1L,
      first_attempt == "incorrect" ~ 0L,
      first_attempt == "hint" ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(kc_sub_skills) & kc_sub_skills != "" & !is.na(outcome_bin))

d_afm_70 <- d_with_skills_70 %>%
  transmute(
    anon_student_id = anon_student_id,
    week_id = week_id,
    kc_sub_skills = kc_sub_skills,
    n_opportunity = as.integer(opportunity_sub_skills),
    outcome_bin = case_when(
      first_attempt == "correct" ~ 1L,
      first_attempt == "incorrect" ~ 0L,
      first_attempt == "hint" ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(kc_sub_skills) & kc_sub_skills != "" & !is.na(outcome_bin))

# Get all unique weeks sorted chronologically
all_weeks <- unique(c(d_afm_30$week_id, d_afm_70$week_id)) %>% sort()
n_weeks <- length(all_weeks)

cat("\nData preprocessing complete.\n")
cat("Total weeks:", n_weeks, "\n")
cat("Date range:", min(all_weeks), "to", max(all_weeks), "\n")
cat("steve_dang_30 observations:", nrow(d_afm_30), "\n")
cat("steve_dang_70 observations:", nrow(d_afm_70), "\n\n")
```

# 2. Set up parallel processing

```{r}
if (!DEBUG_MODE) {
  # Register parallel backend
  cl <- makeCluster(N_CORES)
  registerDoParallel(cl)
  cat("Parallel processing set up with", N_CORES, "cores\n\n")
} else {
  cat("DEBUG MODE: Running sequentially\n\n")
}
```

# 3. Fit rolling window AFM models for both groups

```{r}
cat("Fitting rolling window AFM models for both groups...\n")
cat("Window size:", ROLLING_WINDOW_SIZE, "weeks\n")
cat("Total weeks to process:", n_weeks, "\n")
cat("Using", N_CORES, "cores\n\n")

# Check data before processing
if (nrow(d_afm_30) == 0 || nrow(d_afm_70) == 0) {
  stop("No data available after preprocessing for one or both groups!")
}

# Function to fit AFM models for a given group
fit_afm_for_group <- function(d_afm, group_name, afm_dir) {
  cat("\nProcessing", group_name, "group...\n")
  cat("  Total observations:", nrow(d_afm), "\n")
  cat("  Unique students:", n_distinct(d_afm$anon_student_id), "\n")
  cat("  Unique skills:", n_distinct(d_afm$kc_sub_skills), "\n")
  cat("  Date range:", min(d_afm$week_id), "to", max(d_afm$week_id), "\n")
  
  # Choose parallel or sequential execution
  `%do_operator%` <- if(DEBUG_MODE) `%do%` else `%dopar%`
  
  # Process each week
  combine_results <- function(...) {
    results <- list(...)
    return(results)
  }
  
  rolling_results <- foreach(
    i = 1:n_weeks,
    .packages = c("dplyr", "lme4", "tibble"),
    .combine = combine_results,
    .errorhandling = "pass",
    .multicombine = TRUE,
    .maxcombine = n_weeks
  ) %do_operator% {
    
    current_week <- all_weeks[i]
    
    # Debug output
    if (DEBUG_MODE && (i %% 10 == 1 || i <= 5)) {
      cat("  Processing week", i, "of", n_weeks, ":", current_week, "\n")
    }
    
    # Determine training data window
    if (i < ROLLING_WINDOW_SIZE) {
      # Use all available data up to current week
      window_start_idx <- 1
    } else {
      # Use rolling window
      window_start_idx <- i - ROLLING_WINDOW_SIZE + 1
    }
    
    window_weeks <- all_weeks[window_start_idx:i]
    
    # Filter data for this window
    window_data <- d_afm %>%
      filter(week_id %in% window_weeks)
    
    # Skip if insufficient data
    # Adjust these based on your actual data size
    min_observations <- 100  # Minimum observations per window
    min_students <- 5        # Minimum unique students per window
    min_skills <- 3          # Minimum unique skills per window
    
    if (nrow(window_data) < min_observations || 
        n_distinct(window_data$anon_student_id) < min_students ||
        n_distinct(window_data$kc_sub_skills) < min_skills) {
      if (DEBUG_MODE) {
        cat("  Skipping week", current_week, "- insufficient data:",
            "obs=", nrow(window_data), 
            "students=", n_distinct(window_data$anon_student_id),
            "skills=", n_distinct(window_data$kc_sub_skills), "\n")
      }
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Fit AFM model for this week
    tryCatch({
      m_afm <- glmer(
        outcome_bin ~ n_opportunity + (1 + n_opportunity | anon_student_id) + (1 | kc_sub_skills),
        data = window_data,
        family = binomial,
        nAGQ = 0,
        verbose = 0,
        control = glmerControl(
          optimizer = "bobyqa",
          calc.derivs = FALSE,
          check.conv.grad = .makeCC("warning", tol = 1e-3, relTol = NULL),
          check.conv.singular = .makeCC(action = "ignore", tol = 1e-3),
          check.conv.hess = .makeCC(action = "ignore", tol = 1e-3),
          optCtrl = list(maxfun = 50000)  # Reduced for speed
        )
      )
      
      # Save model
      model_file <- file.path(afm_dir, paste0("afm_model_", group_name, "_", current_week, ".rds"))
      saveRDS(m_afm, file = model_file)
      
      # Extract parameters
      student_effects <- ranef(m_afm)$anon_student_id
      fixed_effects <- fixef(m_afm)
      global_intercept <- fixed_effects["(Intercept)"]
      global_learning_rate <- fixed_effects["n_opportunity"]
      
      student_abilities <- tibble(
        anon_student_id = rownames(student_effects),
        ability_deviation = student_effects[,1],                    # Random effect (deviation)
        learning_rate_deviation = student_effects[,2],              # Random effect (deviation)
        ability = global_intercept + student_effects[,1],           # Total ability  
        learning_rate = global_learning_rate + student_effects[,2], # Total learning rate
        week_id = current_week
      )
      
      skill_effects <- ranef(m_afm)$kc_sub_skills
      skill_easiness <- tibble(
        kc_sub_skills = rownames(skill_effects),
        easiness = skill_effects[,1],
        week_id = current_week
      )
      
      # Store global parameters for this week's model
      global_params <- tibble(
        week_id = current_week,
        global_intercept = global_intercept,
        global_learning_rate = global_learning_rate
      )
      
      # Calculate proficiency for students in current week only
      current_week_data <- window_data %>%
        filter(week_id == current_week)
      
      # Last opportunities for current week
      last_opps <- current_week_data %>%
        group_by(anon_student_id, kc_sub_skills) %>%
        summarise(last_opportunity = max(n_opportunity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
      
      # Predict proficiency
      if (nrow(last_opps) > 0) {
        pred_data <- last_opps %>%
          rename(n_opportunity = last_opportunity)
        
        proficiency_estimates <- pred_data %>%
          mutate(
            proficiency = predict(m_afm, newdata = ., type = "response", allow.new.levels = TRUE),
            week_id = current_week
          )
      } else {
        proficiency_estimates <- tibble()
      }
      
      # Calculate week difficulty using model's skill easiness
      if (nrow(current_week_data) > 0 && nrow(skill_easiness) > 0) {
        skill_encounters <- current_week_data %>%
          group_by(anon_student_id, kc_sub_skills) %>%
          summarise(encounters_this_week = n(), .groups = "drop")
        
        week_difficulty <- skill_encounters %>%
          left_join(skill_easiness, by = "kc_sub_skills") %>%
          filter(!is.na(easiness)) %>%
          group_by(anon_student_id) %>%
          summarise(
            week_easiness = sum(easiness * encounters_this_week) / sum(encounters_this_week),
            week_difficulty = -week_easiness,
            week_id = current_week,
            .groups = "drop"
          ) %>%
          mutate(
            # Replace NaN with NA (occurs when no valid skills)
            week_difficulty = if_else(is.nan(week_difficulty), NA_real_, week_difficulty),
            week_easiness = if_else(is.nan(week_easiness), NA_real_, week_easiness)
          ) %>%
          select(anon_student_id, week_id, week_difficulty)  # Only keep needed columns
      } else {
        week_difficulty <- tibble(
          anon_student_id = character(),
          week_id = character(),
          week_difficulty = numeric()
        )
      }
      
      # Return results 
      # Important: Return the result, not wrapped in another list
      result <- list(
        week_id = current_week,
        window_start = min(window_weeks),
        window_size = length(window_weeks),
        n_students = n_distinct(window_data$anon_student_id),
        n_skills = n_distinct(window_data$kc_sub_skills),
        n_observations = nrow(window_data),
        student_abilities = student_abilities,
        skill_easiness = skill_easiness,
        global_params = global_params,
        proficiency_estimates = proficiency_estimates,
        week_difficulty = week_difficulty,
        model_converged = is.null(m_afm@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages)
      )
      return(result)
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      return(list(
        week_id = current_week,
        error = as.character(e$message)
      ))
    })
  }
  
  return(rolling_results)
}

# Fit AFM models for both groups
rolling_results_30 <- fit_afm_for_group(d_afm_30, "steve_dang_30", AFM_DIR)
rolling_results_70 <- fit_afm_for_group(d_afm_70, "steve_dang_70", AFM_DIR)

cat("\nModel fitting complete for both groups.\n")

# Stop parallel cluster (if used)
if (!DEBUG_MODE) {
  stopCluster(cl)
}
```

# 4. Process results and calculate final metrics

```{r}
cat("\nProcessing results for both groups...\n")

# Function to process results for a group
process_group_results <- function(rolling_results, group_name) {
  cat("\nProcessing", group_name, "results...\n")
  
  # Check if we got any results
  if (is.null(rolling_results) || length(rolling_results) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No results returned from parallel processing for", group_name, "!"))
  }
  
  # Extract successful results (filter out NULLs and errors)
  if (!is.list(rolling_results)) {
    cat("WARNING: rolling_results is not a list! Type:", class(rolling_results), "\n")
    rolling_results <- list(rolling_results)
  }
  
  # Debug what we got
  cat("  Total results:", length(rolling_results), "\n")
  null_results <- sum(sapply(rolling_results, is.null))
  cat("  NULL results (insufficient data):", null_results, "\n")
  
  # Extract successful weeks
  successful_weeks <- Filter(function(x) {
    !is.null(x) && is.list(x) && is.null(x$error) && !is.null(x$week_id)
  }, rolling_results)
  
  if (length(successful_weeks) == 0) {
    # Check for errors
    errors <- Filter(function(x) !is.null(x) && !is.null(x$error), rolling_results)
    if (length(errors) > 0) {
      cat("Errors encountered:\n")
      for (e in errors) {
        cat("  Week", e$week_id, ":", e$error, "\n")
      }
    }
    
    # If all results are NULL, it means all weeks had insufficient data
    if (null_results == length(rolling_results)) {
      cat("All weeks skipped due to insufficient data. Consider:\n")
      cat("  - Using a larger sample percentage\n")
      cat("  - Reducing minimum data thresholds\n")
      cat("  - Checking if data is properly loaded\n")
    }
    
    stop(paste("No models were successfully fitted for", group_name, "!"))
  }
  
  cat("Successfully processed", length(successful_weeks), "weeks for", group_name, "\n")
  
  return(successful_weeks)
}

# Process results for both groups
# Use tryCatch to handle cases where no models were fitted
successful_weeks_30 <- tryCatch({
  process_group_results(rolling_results_30, "steve_dang_30")
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("Warning:", e$message, "\n")
  cat("Continuing with behavioral metrics only for steve_dang_30\n")
  list()  # Empty list means no AFM features
})

successful_weeks_70 <- tryCatch({
  process_group_results(rolling_results_70, "steve_dang_70")
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("Warning:", e$message, "\n")
  cat("Continuing with behavioral metrics only for steve_dang_70\n")
  list()  # Empty list means no AFM features
})

# Function to extract metrics from successful weeks
extract_metrics <- function(successful_weeks, group_name) {
  cat("\nExtracting metrics for", group_name, "...\n")
  
  # Handle empty successful_weeks (no AFM models fitted)
  if (length(successful_weeks) == 0) {
    cat("  No AFM models available - returning empty metrics\n")
    return(list(
      proficiency = tibble(),
      difficulty = tibble(
        anon_student_id = character(),
        week_id = character(), 
        week_difficulty = numeric()
      ),
      student_abilities = tibble(
        anon_student_id = character(),
        ability_deviation = numeric(),
        learning_rate_deviation = numeric(),
        ability = numeric(),
        learning_rate = numeric(),
        week_id = character()
      ),
      skill_easiness = tibble(
        kc_sub_skills = character(),
        easiness = numeric(),
        week_id = character()
      ),
      global_params = tibble(
        week_id = character(),
        global_intercept = numeric(),
        global_learning_rate = numeric()
      ),
      metadata = tibble(
        week_id = character(),
        window_start = character(),
        window_size = numeric(),
        model_converged = logical()
      )
    ))
  }
  
  # Combine proficiency estimates
  all_proficiency <- bind_rows(lapply(successful_weeks, function(x) x$proficiency_estimates))
  
  # Combine week difficulty
  all_difficulty_list <- lapply(successful_weeks, function(x) x$week_difficulty)
  all_difficulty_non_null <- all_difficulty_list[!sapply(all_difficulty_list, is.null)]
  
  if (length(all_difficulty_non_null) > 0) {
    all_difficulty <- bind_rows(all_difficulty_non_null)
  } else {
    # Create empty tibble with correct structure
    all_difficulty <- tibble(
      anon_student_id = character(),
      week_id = character(), 
      week_difficulty = numeric()
    )
  }
  
  # Extract student abilities
  all_student_abilities <- bind_rows(lapply(successful_weeks, function(x) x$student_abilities))
  all_skill_easiness <- bind_rows(lapply(successful_weeks, function(x) x$skill_easiness))
  all_global_params <- bind_rows(lapply(successful_weeks, function(x) x$global_params))
  
  # Extract metadata
  model_metadata <- bind_rows(lapply(successful_weeks, function(x) {
    tibble(
      week_id = x$week_id,
      window_start = x$window_start,
      window_size = x$window_size,
      model_converged = x$model_converged
    )
  }))
  
  return(list(
    proficiency = all_proficiency,
    difficulty = all_difficulty,
    student_abilities = all_student_abilities,
    skill_easiness = all_skill_easiness,
    global_params = all_global_params,
    metadata = model_metadata
  ))
}

# Extract metrics for both groups
metrics_30 <- extract_metrics(successful_weeks_30, "steve_dang_30")
metrics_70 <- extract_metrics(successful_weeks_70, "steve_dang_70")

# Function to calculate proficiency metrics
calculate_proficiency <- function(all_proficiency, student_ids, all_weeks) {
  if (PROFICIENCY_METHOD == "mean") {
    avg_proficiency <- all_proficiency %>%
      group_by(anon_student_id, week_id) %>%
      summarise(
        avg_proficiency = mean(proficiency, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_skills_measured = n(),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  } else if (PROFICIENCY_METHOD == "new_skills_mastered") {
    # Find first mastery week for each skill
    if (nrow(all_proficiency) > 0) {
      first_mastery <- all_proficiency %>%
        filter(proficiency > 0.95) %>%
        group_by(anon_student_id, kc_sub_skills) %>%
        summarise(first_mastery_week = min(week_id), .groups = "drop")
      
      # Count new masteries per week
      if (nrow(first_mastery) > 0) {
        new_skills_per_week <- first_mastery %>%
          group_by(anon_student_id, first_mastery_week) %>%
          summarise(new_skills_mastered = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
          rename(week_id = first_mastery_week)
      } else {
        new_skills_per_week <- tibble(anon_student_id = character(), 
                                      week_id = character(), 
                                      new_skills_mastered = numeric())
      }
    } else {
      new_skills_per_week <- tibble(anon_student_id = character(), 
                                    week_id = character(), 
                                    new_skills_mastered = numeric())
    }
    
    # Create full grid and fill zeros
    student_week_grid <- expand_grid(
      anon_student_id = student_ids,
      week_id = all_weeks
    )
    
    avg_proficiency <- student_week_grid %>%
      left_join(new_skills_per_week, by = c("anon_student_id", "week_id")) %>%
      mutate(
        avg_proficiency = replace_na(new_skills_mastered, 0),
        # NA because not applicable to this method of calculating proficiency
        n_skills_measured = NA_integer_
      ) %>%
      select(-new_skills_mastered)
  }
  
  return(avg_proficiency)
}

# Calculate proficiency for both groups
avg_proficiency_30 <- calculate_proficiency(metrics_30$proficiency, 
                                             unique(d_with_week_id_30$anon_student_id), 
                                             all_weeks)
avg_proficiency_70 <- calculate_proficiency(metrics_70$proficiency, 
                                             unique(d_with_week_id_70$anon_student_id), 
                                             all_weeks)

# Calculate behavioral metrics (from original data, not model-specific)
# Process both groups
student_week_basic_30 <- d_with_week_id_30 %>%
  group_by(anon_student_id, week_id) %>%
  reframe(
    minutes_per_week = sum(duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE) / 60,
    problems_solved = n_distinct(problem_name),
    total_opportunities = n()
  )

student_week_basic_70 <- d_with_week_id_70 %>%
  group_by(anon_student_id, week_id) %>%
  reframe(
    minutes_per_week = sum(duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE) / 60,
    problems_solved = n_distinct(problem_name),
    total_opportunities = n()
  )

# Prepare student abilities for joining
# Handle empty dataframes (when no AFM models were fitted)
if (nrow(metrics_30$student_abilities) > 0) {
  student_abilities_for_join_30 <- metrics_30$student_abilities %>%
    select(anon_student_id, week_id, student_ability = ability, student_learning_rate = learning_rate)
} else {
  student_abilities_for_join_30 <- tibble(
    anon_student_id = character(),
    week_id = character(),
    student_ability = numeric(),
    student_learning_rate = numeric()
  )
}

if (nrow(metrics_70$student_abilities) > 0) {
  student_abilities_for_join_70 <- metrics_70$student_abilities %>%
    select(anon_student_id, week_id, student_ability = ability, student_learning_rate = learning_rate)
} else {
  student_abilities_for_join_70 <- tibble(
    anon_student_id = character(),
    week_id = character(),
    student_ability = numeric(),
    student_learning_rate = numeric()
  )
}

# Create final aggregations for both groups
final_aggregation_30 <- student_week_basic_30 %>%
  left_join(avg_proficiency_30, by = c("anon_student_id", "week_id")) %>%
  left_join(metrics_30$difficulty, by = c("anon_student_id", "week_id")) %>%
  left_join(student_abilities_for_join_30, by = c("anon_student_id", "week_id")) %>%
  arrange(anon_student_id, week_id)

final_aggregation_70 <- student_week_basic_70 %>%
  left_join(avg_proficiency_70, by = c("anon_student_id", "week_id")) %>%
  left_join(metrics_70$difficulty, by = c("anon_student_id", "week_id")) %>%
  left_join(student_abilities_for_join_70, by = c("anon_student_id", "week_id")) %>%
  arrange(anon_student_id, week_id)

# We now have two separate final aggregations for the two groups

cat("  Rows in final_aggregation_30:", nrow(final_aggregation_30), "\n")
cat("  Rows in final_aggregation_70:", nrow(final_aggregation_70), "\n")
cat("  Columns in output:", paste(names(final_aggregation_30), collapse = ", "), "\n")

cat("  Rows with non-NA week_difficulty:", sum(!is.na(final_aggregation_70$week_difficulty)), "\n")
cat("  Rows with non-NA student_ability:", sum(!is.na(final_aggregation_70$student_ability)), "\n")
```

```{r}
if (interactive()) {
  library(ggplot2)
  
  # Plot average proficiency over time (combined data)
  combined_data <- bind_rows(
    mutate(final_aggregation_30, group = "steve_dang_30"),
    mutate(final_aggregation_70, group = "steve_dang_70")
  )
  
  avg_by_week_group <- combined_data %>%
    group_by(week_id, group) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_proficiency = mean(avg_proficiency, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_difficulty = mean(week_difficulty, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  p1 <- ggplot(avg_by_week_group, aes(x = week_id, y = mean_proficiency, color = group)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 1) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(title = "Average Proficiency Over Time by Group",
         x = "Week", y = "Mean Proficiency",
         color = "Group")
  
  print(p1)
  
  # Plot week difficulty over time
  p2 <- ggplot(avg_by_week_group, aes(x = week_id, y = mean_difficulty, color = group)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 1) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(title = "Average Week Difficulty Over Time by Group",
         x = "Week", y = "Mean Difficulty",
         color = "Group")
  
  print(p2)
}
``` 
